alligator.desc: Don`t make the mistake of thinking the log in the swamp isnt moving!
alligator.name: Alligator

amputate.desc: Amputate is a powerful pole weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
amputate.name: Amputate

ankylosaur.desc: The construction workers of Sandydale Basin have given great thought to employing these beasts for demolition work.
ankylosaur.name: Ankylosaur

arachnin.desc: Quite literally Arachnin means spider people in old Myzan, they are a race of half humanoid/half spider.
arachnin.name: Arachnin

ariaxis.desc: The leader of the Dark Hollow Clan faction.
ariaxis.name: Ariaxis

baron-drako.desc: Ruler of the Estate, a small Society encampment, Drako is not really a Baron, he just wishes he were so has taken the title for himself.
baron-drako.name: Baron Drako

barrage.desc: Barrage is a powerful two-handed weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
barrage.name: Barrage

barren-downs.desc: A dusty and dry place, with a large desert it is a hard land to live in but people do live here and there are some excellent towns to visit.
barren-downs.name: Barren Downs

barricade.desc: Barricade is a powerful two-handed shield artifact. This card is super rare!
barricade.name: Barricade

basilisk.desc: A leathery skinned giant lizard, said to turn its foes to stone but more than likely just employs a paralysing agent.
basilisk.name: Basilisk

bat.desc: Often believed to be the vanguard of the Reapers, or Vampires out for a stroll, but most often than not simply a Bat.
bat.name: Bat

bean-sidhe.desc: The Bean Sidhe is a spirit or fairy who presage a death by wailing.
bean-sidhe.name: Bean sidhe

blade-of-the-4-winds.desc: Blade of the Four Winds is a powerful weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
blade-of-the-4-winds.name: Blade of the 4 Winds

bloody-reaper.desc:
Servants of the Underworld, who walk among us claiming the souls of mortals.

Typically doing so through murder.
bloody-reaper.name: Bloody Reaper

bogle.desc: They are reputed to live for the simple purpose of torturing young children that disobey their mothers, or of punishing those that are lazy, or guilty of crimes.
bogle.name: Bogle

bombardment.desc: Bombardment is a powerful siege weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
bombardment.name: Bombardment

campire.desc: At Halloween when people dress up in cheesy costumes, this fearsome monster walks among us ...
campire.name: Campire

cat.desc: Cats are cousins of wild cats like Tigers, they may look cute and cuddly but they would happily claw your eyes out if threatened.
cat.name: Cat

centaur.desc: A noble race of horse people, they are fearsome hunters and warriors and are said to be guardians of the forest.
centaur.name: Centaur

chat-rules.desc:
I am the Law!

You will respect my authority!

Or no cookies for you!
chat-rules.name: Chat Rules

cinder-beast.desc: These ferocious beasts are said to be the guardians of the entrance to the Underworld.
cinder-beast.name: Cinder Beast

coldbreeze.desc: A small oasis of land exists seemingly out of phase with the rest of this land near the southern border. Natural hot springs heat a valley making it habitable.
coldbreeze.name: Coldbreeze

commander-eversight.desc: A good and honorable man, leader of the Explorers Guild expedition into the newly discovered realm of Juratania, he is also Mayor of Camp Eversight.
commander-eversight.name: Commander Eversight

commander-montagnon.desc: The leader of the Knights Templar and a beacon of light in the darkness.
commander-montagnon.name: Commander Montagnon

cookie-monster.desc: Awww so cute and deadly, yet secretly delicious!
cookie-monster.name: Cookie Monster

cookie-power.desc: Referred to as the Emergency Medicinal Cookie, this item has been known to save lives in an emergency.
cookie-power.name: Cookie Power

creeper.desc: If you go down to the woods today, watch out for fearsome plants!
creeper.name: Creeper

crocodile.desc: If you can see the eyes of a Crocodile, consider backing away as fast as your wee legs can take you.
crocodile.name: Crocodile

crossfire.desc: Crossfire is a powerful crossbow weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
crossfire.name: Crossfire

cyclops.desc: This race of humanoids evolved with only one eye, they are strong and have good hearing to compensate for having no depth perception.
cyclops.name: Cyclops

dark-dwarf.desc: A few hundred years ago, a group of dwarves splintered off from the others, and started following the path of darkness.
dark-dwarf.name: Dark Dwarf

darkness.desc: Darkness is a powerful mace weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
darkness.name: Darkness

death-star.desc: Death Star is a powerful weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
death-star.name: Death Star

deathscarab.desc: A hard shelled beetle that has often been associated with death.
deathscarab.name: Deathscarab

decimate.desc: Decimate is a powerful heavy-munitions weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
decimate.name: Decimate

destruction.desc: Destruction is a powerful fist weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
destruction.name: Destruction

dirk-shady-johns.desc: Never turn your back on this guy, and make sure your backpack and pockets are securely fastened.
dirk-shady-johns.name: Dirk 'Shady' Johns

discharge.desc: Discharge is a powerful hand gun weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
discharge.name: Discharge

dog.desc: Dogs are cousins of wolves that were domesticated by hunters and made more docile by generations of breeding.
dog.name: Dog

downfall.desc: Downfall is a powerful stave weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
downfall.name: Downfall

dragon.desc: Dragons come in many sizes and shapes, some can fly, some can breathe fire. They are all very deadly!
dragon.name: Dragon

dragonflyer.desc: A cross between a dragon and a dragonfly, these large insects are often used as mounts to the people in Juratania.
dragonflyer.name: Dragonflyer

drake.desc: A band of Dragons made a pact with a spirit to grant them eternal flight. The spirit took their ability to breathe fire, and called them Drakes.
drake.name: Drake

dryad.desc: A race of forest spirits, they exist as energy in travel form but if they choose they can show their true form.
dryad.name: Dryad

duck.desc: A wetlands bird, hunted to the brink of extinction. The Duck is known to many by its distinctive quack.
duck.name: Duck

duncan-the-odd.desc: While you may call him Duncan the Odd, just imagine what he calls you behind your back!
duncan-the-odd.name: Duncan the Odd

elder-dragon.desc: As if ordinary Dragons werent bad enough, the Elder Dragon is the thing of nightmares .... it burns and destroys all in its path in its search for Ash.
elder-dragon.name: Elder Dragon

elementaria.desc: A magical entity that lives in the River Estate and eminates power.
elementaria.name: Elementaria

elenora-armus.desc: Assigned as Chief Healer on the Eversight Expedition, rumor has it that her and Commander Eversight are lovers.
elenora-armus.name: Elenora Armus

essence.desc: A race of pure energy beings, when they come into contact with something evil or good an imprint of that is left behind and it may turn them towards the darkness or the light.
essence.name: Essence

exiles.desc: The Exiles are loyal followers of Morgan and Vanessa Blackcrest the true King and Queen of Myzan.
exiles.name: Exiles

extinction.desc: Extinction is a powerful two-handed sword artifact. This card is super rare!
extinction.name: Extinction

faith.desc: Faith is a powerful fist weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
faith.name: Faith

fatality.desc: Fatality is a powerful sword weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
fatality.name: Fatality

feralkin.desc: Werewolves are so last century, this years fad is Werecats!
feralkin.name: Feralkin

frostvale.desc: This cold land is in a constant frozen state, the plants and trees that grow here have adapted to live in the coldness.
frostvale.name: Frostvale

gash.desc: Gash is a powerful axe weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
gash.name: Gash

genie.desc: These ethereal entities are said to grant 3 wishes to any soul that can find and retrieve their magic vessel. They are mischevious and twist wishes to suit them.
genie.name: Genie

ghast.desc: Ghasts are one of the Underworlds many soldiers in the mortal plain. Unlike ghosts these undeads have physical form and can deal great pain.
ghast.name: Ghast

giant-beetle.desc: Giant relatives of the ordinary beetle, these insects turned to eating meat to sate their hunger.
giant-beetle.name: Giant Beetle

giant-crab.desc: Giant relatives of the humble crab, they have huge claws that have been known to crush a man and cut him clean in half.
giant-crab.name: Giant Crab

giant-salamander.desc: Giant relatives of the salamander, these large lizards still eat vegetation but do so on a massive scale.
giant-salamander.name: Giant Salamander

giant-scorpion.desc: Giant relatives of the scorpion, these beasts have an extremely potent poison, one small drop is enough to kill an adult human.
giant-scorpion.name: Giant Scorpion

gnome.desc: Gnomes are a race of small people that live in underground homes and caves, they have a natural affinity to the earth and all things in it.
gnome.name: Gnome

goat.desc: A hardy species of animal that often lives in mountains or in places there is not enough grass to keep sheep.
goat.name: Goat

goblin.desc: Goblins are greedy creatures, which is why the Traders Alliance has brought them on board to work in the banks and mints of Myzan.
goblin.name: Goblin

grief.desc: Grief is a powerful propelled weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
grief.name: Grief

grim-reaper.desc: They walk among us claiming the souls of mortals, usually claiming your soul shortly before an accident can claim it.
grim-reaper.name: Grim Reaper

gryphon.desc: Created by the God of the Air these giant birds served as guardians of the Air until man found and trapped several, breeding them to serve as mounts.
gryphon.name: Gryphon

guide-derwa.desc: A helpful soul who lives on the Estate, she is the leader of Drako's slaves, some might argue she has more power than him.
guide-derwa.name: Guide Derwa

gyrian.desc: A race of flying humanoids, covered in feathers from head to toe they are excellent fliers and love to spend hours in the air.
gyrian.name: Gyrian

harm.desc: Harm is a powerful thrown magic weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
harm.name: Harm

hellbeast.desc: From the depths of Hell comes this creature ... it may only pass to the land of the living by oozing up through lava and volcanic passages which may take years.
hellbeast.name: Hellbeast

hellsgate.desc: A horridly evil and violent place, only the insane or truly despicable visit this place. Be careful visitors have been known to disappear.
hellsgate.name: Hellsgate

honor.desc: Honor is a powerful artifact item. This card is super rare!
honor.name: Honor

hope-credit.desc: Wars have been fought over these highly sought after and valuable relics.
hope-credit.name: Hope Credit

human.desc: A race of versatile beings, that like change and adapt to almost any situation.
human.name: Human

hydra.desc: A multi-headed beast, normally all three heads work in unison but it has been known for a hero to best such a creature by confusing a head.
hydra.name: Hydra

hydraxia.desc: Sea Goddess and full time mom in the Shrouded Isles.
hydraxia.name: Hydraxia

ilandria.desc: The soon to be savior of Myzan and all round nice person.
ilandria.name: Ilandria

infliction.desc: Infliction is a powerful exotic weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
infliction.name: Infliction

insight.desc: Insight is a powerful enchanted weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
insight.name: Insight

jackal.desc: The Jackal lives by its wits, it rarely attacks and kills prey and instead scavengers meat from the kills of others.
jackal.name: Jackal

jellyfish.desc: Jellyfish are often found in the oceans, although some species have been found that can live in the rivers.
jellyfish.name: Jellyfish

juratania.desc: A newly discovered realm, it has many strange and wonderful animals and plants and is currently the focus of attention for the Explorers Guild.
juratania.name: Juratania

kaelia-kaka.desc: One of the first people you meet after leaving the Estate, Kaelia will teach you a trick or two ... Appraisal, Exploration and Skinning too.
kaelia-kaka.name: Kaelia Kaka

killerwasp.desc: These Killerwasps are always in a ferocious rage, no one understands what causes it but they will ferociously attack anything.
killerwasp.name: Killerwasp

king-arthur.desc: The fabled ruler of Camelot, no one knows how he got to Myzan. Aliens perhaps?
king-arthur.name: King Arthur

knotwood-valley.desc: A wonderful place with forests and rivers and oceans, a diverse eco-system ensures this realm thrives.
knotwood-valley.name: Knotwood Valley

lakeview.desc: A realm named for the massive lake that can be viewed from almost any corner of the land. It has some excellent fishing possibilities.
lakeview.name: Lakeview

liche.desc: A Liche is a type of undead creature, usually an evil magician or a powerful undead king that torments the living.
liche.name: Liche

lion.desc: A race of big cats, that hunt in packs. They employ hit and run attacks on large beasts, slowly injuring them or running them to the point of exhaustion.
lion.name: Lion

lizard.desc: These small reptiles eat plant leaves and small insects, they are hardly deadly but some have been known to spit acid or other toxins.
lizard.name: Lizard

lizardman.desc: A tough skinned Humanoid race that developed from a hardy race of mountain humans who were forced to pleade loyalty to a forest spirit.
lizardman.name: Lizardman

mad-dog-murphy.desc: Dog, was perhaps one of the greatest hunters Myzan had known for generations, after a hunting accident he hung up his rifle and now hires people to hunt.
mad-dog-murphy.name: Mad 'Dog' Murphy

mantrap.desc: Found in the deepest jungles, these plants attract animals to the sweet fruit that grows inside their trap then snap shut and use acid to drink whatever prey they caught.
mantrap.name: Mantrap

melinda.desc: Melinda is said to be Drakos child from an ilicit love affair with a serving wench, he promised to take care of Melinda and see her well.
melinda.name: Melinda

melody.desc: Melody is is a powerful instrument weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
melody.name: Melody

merlin.desc: The magical advisor to King Arthur, no one knows how he got to Myzan. Aliens perhaps?
merlin.name: Merlin

morgana.desc: The diabolical queen of dark magic no one knows how she got to Myzan. Aliens perhaps?
morgana.name: Morgana

morphet.desc: These curious creatures have the power to transform their appearance, they use this trick to escape predators.
morphet.name: Morphet

murkeye.desc: A fearsome beast that lives in the River Estate and devours small children and slow adults.
murkeye.name: Murkeye

myzan.desc:
The planet of Myzan is one planet in an ocean of stars.

What makes this planet special is You!
myzan.name: Myzan

neanderthal.desc: A primative sub-species of Human, they never evovled the complex brain structure latter Humans developed. All they are good for is Geico ads.
neanderthal.name: Neanderthal

nightmare.desc: Sometimes called Hellsteeds these fiery maned mounts are used by some of the Darker souls in Myzan.
nightmare.name: Nightmare

oblivion.desc: Oblivion is a powerful two-handed mace weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
oblivion.name: Oblivion

obstruction.desc: Obstruction is a powerful shield artifact. This card is super rare!
obstruction.name: Obstruction

ogre.desc: Ogre's are a very violent race, they are often put to work in Deconstruction as they love to smash and bash things.
ogre.name: Ogre

pack-horse.desc: Bred as beasts of burden these horses, are required to carry heavy loads across great distances.
pack-horse.name: Pack Horse

patricia-preystalker.desc: The Estate hunter, it is her responsibility to hunt and kill animals that stray onto the estate, and also to provide meat for Drako's table.
patricia-preystalker.name: Patricia Preystalker

pegasus.desc: These flying mounts, are pure white and favoured by Heros and good souls as the mount of choice.
pegasus.name: Pegasus

proudhorn.desc: The leader of the Myzan Defenders faction.
proudhorn.name: Proudhorn

pterosaurus.desc: These flying monsters, were recently encountered for the first time in the forgotten land of Juratania. They are awesome predators and carnivores by nature.
pterosaurus.name: Pterosaurus

rabid-dog.desc: While Dogs were being domesticated a few animals showed signs of aggression going beyond that of even Wolves, these animals were labelled rabid and destroyed.
rabid-dog.name: Rabid Dog

raptor.desc: These ferocious predators were recently discovered in Juratania, they have been the cause of many attacks and killed a number of peasants and soldiers.
raptor.name: Raptor

ratillian.desc: Some believe these animals to be the result of a chance encounter between a Rat and a Lizard, they certainly bare resemblance to both.
ratillian.name: Ratillian

reapers.desc: The Reapers were thought to be a thing of legends, a story parents used to scare children for generations.
reapers.name: Reapers

redcap.desc: This odd monster was first encountered deep in the woods in a place no one had ventured for years. It is not something you should make mushroom soup from.
redcap.name: Redcap

redhide-firemane.desc: An elder fox, some say the mother of the fox race itself and born from the fires of life.
redhide-firemane.name: Redhide Firemane

redskin-foureyes.desc: An ancient spider that was given sentient thought by Mosslord the leader of the Druids, Redskin teaches Druids how to use Poison.
redskin-foureyes.name: Redskin Foureyes

rend.desc: Rend is a powerful two-handed axe weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
rend.name: Rend

riverscape.desc: A refreshing realm with bright green forests and medows, punctuated by long and winding rivers. A great place to go for a Holiday.
riverscape.name: Riverscape

royal-hollow.desc: A realm bordered by a big mountain range, with only one pass in it has been favored by Kings and Queens for its easy to defend location.
royal-hollow.name: Royal Hollow

ruination.desc: Ruination is a powerful two-handed stave artifact. This card is super rare!
ruination.name: Ruination

sabretooth-tiger.desc: A ferocious animal, with two large upper teeth that are used to snap the necks of its prey. While its smaller cousins prefer to hunt in packs, these Tigers are solitary.
sabretooth-tiger.name: Sabretooth Tiger

sakure.desc: The soon to be ruler of Myzan and enslaver of the lower species.
sakure.name: Sakure

sandydale-basin.desc: For a land with at least thirty percent of water it is a dry land, with large tracts of desert and a constant salty sea breeze.
sandydale-basin.name: Sandydale Basin

scar.desc: A strange creature that can be found on the River Estate ... what secrets does it guard.
scar.name: Scar

scavenger.desc: As the name suggests these birds are scavengers, they rarely make a kill and instead rely on stealing scraps from the kills of others.
scavenger.name: Scavenger

sea-king.desc: The ruler of the Shrouded Isles and part time demented sea monster.
sea-king.name: Sea King

seven-sisters.desc: This land is said to be named after the seven islands that exist in the ocean, rumored to be made by the deaths of seven powerful witches.
seven-sisters.name: Seven Sisters

shade.desc: If you have ever seen something out of the corner of your eye, but when you turn to face it there is nothing there then you have probably seen a Shade.
shade.name: Shade

shark.desc: Perhaps one of the most ferocious beasts to swim in the oceans, Sharks have very powerful jaws that can be used to snap bones clean in two.
shark.name: Shark

sithe-lord.desc: The Sithe are a slave race they were created as foot soldiers by a powerful spirit, they await the day when she will return and lead them to glory.
sithe-lord.name: Sithe Lord

skeleton.desc: Skeletons are re-animated corpses that were either brought back by inferior Necromancers, or brought back to life a long time after death.
skeleton.name: Skeleton

slash.desc: Slash is a powerful dagger weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
slash.name: Slash

slug.desc: Elusive monsters, that prefer damp environments. You can often tell where one has been from the thin layer of slug goop they secrete.
slug.name: Slug

society.desc: The Society are followers of Victor and Sophia Ramirez, who led a blood coup against the throne and took power.
society.name: Society

stegosaurus.desc: Recognised by the thick ridges protruding from their backs. These help prevent aerial assaults from Pterosaurs and leaping attacks from Raptors.
stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus

stenopterygius.desc: These monsters resemble a cross between a fish and a shark, they have been found dwelling in the rivers of Juratania.
stenopterygius.name: Stenopterygius

supernova.desc: Supernova is a powerful celestial weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
supernova.name: Supernova

sylph.desc: Sylphs prefer to live in water however they are tied to the forests like Dryads and forced to live in ponds and streams and places where water gathers.
sylph.name: Sylph

the-darkness.desc: An evil entity from the underworld, as more things die it grows in power!
the-darkness.name: The Darkness

three-glaciers.desc: This land is dominated by three glaciers that are constantly working against each other. It is said that they are three arguing brothers.
three-glaciers.name: Three Glaciers

tiger.desc: Tigers live and hunt in the tundra and desert plains, the odd markings and stripes they have help camouflage them and allow them to attack from close range.
tiger.name: Tiger

torment.desc: Torment is a powerful thrown weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
torment.name: Torment

triceratops.desc: A usually timid animal that eats plants, its head is armored and has three horns that are used in mating rituals and in defense.
triceratops.name: Triceratops

trollsgrove.desc: A warm and welcoming place, where people get together for such things as Knit club and Bakers Anonymous.
trollsgrove.name: Trollsgrove

vanessa.desc: The Estate Healer, if you fall down or scrape your knee or have any kind of boo boo she is there for you!
vanessa.name: Vanessa

varelia-bloodwitch.desc: Varelia is a witch, as her name might suggest. She is a powerful Alchemist and can teach anyone with the skill a thing or two.
varelia-bloodwitch.name: Varelia Bloodwitch

varelia-woundmender.desc: The Springlade Healer, Varelia is in charge of fixing broken bones, cuts and accidentaly limb severing. Her cures might not smell good but they work well.
varelia-woundmender.name: Varelia Woundmender

volley.desc: Volley is a powerful bow weapon artifact. This card is super rare!
volley.name: Volley

whitefang-deathguard.desc: One of the most fearsome Deathguard to ever live, Whitefang was believed killed centuries ago.
whitefang-deathguard.name: Whitefang Deathguard

winter-elf.desc: During Winter these curious blue Elves are brought into our world, they bring festive cheer and are employed by Oldman Wintersvale to deliver presents.
winter-elf.name: Winter Elf

woode.desc: These tree like monsters are believed to be guardians of the forest, they protect the trees from invaders, Lumberjacks and Fire spirits.
woode.name: Woode

zombie.desc: Said to be driven by the thirst for brains, these re-animated souls seek the living to regain what was taken from them .... Brains!!!
zombie.name: Zombie
